storms.name: Radiation Belt Alpha
storms.description: Intense radiation zone causing gradual hull damage. Often found near gas giants.

storms.name: Gravitational Anomaly Beta
storms.description: Spacetime distortion causing thrust inefficiency. Common in binary systems.

storms.name: Ion Storm Alpha
storms.description: Electromagnetic disturbance that disrupts shields and sensors. Common near active stars.

storms.name: Dark Nebula Beta
storms.description: Dense gas cloud that slows travel but provides cover. Minimal direct harm.
